name: rushlink
description: RushLink by Cygma Audio — unofficial HeadRush companion for tone discovery, rig editing and live performance.

scripts.test:stagehand: vitest run src/domain/live-layout.test.ts src/domain/stage-actions.test.ts src/domain/stage-gestures.test.ts src/domain/stage-midi.test.ts src/domain/headrush-midi.test.ts src/domain/stagehand-catalogue.test.ts src/services/device-api.test.ts src/services/midi-connection.test.tsx src/stores/stagehand.test.ts src/pages/live-play.test.tsx src/pages/live-play-conditional.test.tsx src/pages/live-play-screen.test.tsx src/hooks/use-stage-fullscreen.test.tsx
scripts.test:tablet: playwright test e2e/tablet-layout.spec.ts e2e/tablet-rotation.spec.ts e2e/tablet-touch.spec.ts e2e/stagehand-containment.spec.ts --workers=2
scripts.test:phone: playwright test e2e/phone-layout.spec.ts e2e/phone-workflows.spec.ts e2e/phone-paging.spec.ts e2e/stagehand-containment.spec.ts --workers=2
scripts.test:e2e:production: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.production.config.ts
scripts.test:all: npm run test:coverage:all && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:ci: npm run check:repo && npm run release:check && npm run test:native && npm run test:coverage:all && npm run test:stability:ci && npm run test:e2e
